title: Foreign drawing audit
summary: Read a drawing somebody else made without changing it: declared against inferred units, robust extents and the outliers that stretch them, clusters, layer disciplines, topology defects and every drafting check, each claim with its evidence.

notes: Every step reads; the revision checks prove the drawing was not modified. A disagreement between declared and inferred units is a finding with its numbers, never a correction.
On a live seat the readers snapshot the document through Document.Export, which never renames it.

drawing_topology_check is not a step: it checks the layers drawing_understand classifies as piping or electrical and refuses a drawing with none. Run it after the audit with the layers the understand report names.

drawing.description: The drawing to audit (DXF; a DWG only on a live seat).

steps.purpose: Record the content revision before the audit.
One report: units declared vs inferred, extents and outliers, clusters, layer disciplines, tags, rooms, languages, blocks, layouts, title block.
steps.evidence: units (with every evidence item), extents.outliers by handle, clusters, layers with their discipline and confidence, warnings.

steps.purpose: Every drafting check, every domain focus silent outside its domain; the three topo_* focuses report dangling ends, near misses and crossings on the layers no semantic focus covers.
steps.evidence: The issue list with severity, focus, message and handles.

steps.purpose: Record the revision after the audit.
steps.evidence: The same document_id and revision as before.

postconditions.says: The unit the geometry implies is stated beside the declared one.
Whether the declared and the inferred unit agree is stated.
Robust extents are reported, with the outliers that stretch the declared ones.
The drafting checks ran and listed their findings.
The audit read the document that was opened.
The audit did not modify the drawing.
The drawing's saved state is as it was opened.
